title: watch: SSE frame accumulation has no size limit — unbounded memory growth
description: In watch_once (watch.rs:329), frame_lines accumulates SSE lines between blank-line separators. There is no bound on frame size or line count. A misbehaving kithd (or compromised server) sending an infinite SSE stream with no blank-line terminator causes frame_lines to grow until the process runs out of memory. MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES protects JMAP POST responses but not the SSE stream. Fix: reject frames exceeding a reasonable size (e.g. 64 KiB) or enforce a max line count.
